methodology.observed: Browser Performance API, Long Tasks API, requestAnimationFrame, synchronous callback timings, DOM mutation latency and Chromium precise heap size.
methodology.estimated: Dropped-frame counts are estimated from frame intervals above 16.7 ms. Audio output and USB/driver latency are not measured.

estimated_dropped_frames.method: Frame intervals above 16.7 ms; this is an estimate, not compositor telemetry.
